name: Beginner & Blind Johannesburg 2025
information: Welcome to Beginner & Blind Joburg 2025! This competition focuses on blindfolded events on day 1 and the beginner friendly events on day 2. If you are only coming for the beginner friendly events, you don't have to be there on day 1, come join us for a weekend of cubing fun! All competitors are expected to help out with volunteering - judging, running, and scrambling - please see the Competitor Information and FAQ tabs. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODYxNTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--07b6c24fa981292a6f4b6c84f7c1359bd733368b/IMG_8051.jpeg) A huge thanks to [Cubestuff](https://www.cubestuff.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please support the shop at the competition and check out their website for all your cubing needs.
